title: Yoba language
description: Extinct Austronesian language of Papua New Guinea
extract: Yoba is an extinct Austronesian language of Papua New Guinea. It was restructured through contact with neighboring Papuan languages, and in turn influencing them, before speakers shifted to those languages.
